meta_description: Rex Towing serving Wingate - towing that shows up when you call.
h1_emph: A higher standard of towing in Wingate.
hero_lede: Towing done right. Call and we will take a look.
coverage_h2: Wingate, and the towns around it
cta_h2: Call us and we will come to you
about_p1: We handle towing for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers motorcycle transport, powersports and small equipment, winch-out and recovery. We work out of Wingate and the towns around it.
area_h2: We work in and around Wingate
svc_hero_h1: The towing work we take on

services.title: Motorcycle transport
services.body: Bikes go on the deck with soft ties and a wheel chock so nothing is clamped to a frame or a fork that was never meant to take it.
services.alt: Box truck under tow behind the wrecker
services.evidence: Motorcycle secured upright on the flatbed deck with soft straps

services.title: Powersports and small equipment
services.body: Golf carts and yard machines are winched up and strapped down the same way a car is, so they arrive the way they left.
services.alt: Wheeled tool cabinet loaded and secured on the deck
services.evidence: Side by side utility vehicles loaded and strapped on the flatbed

services.title: Winch-out and recovery
services.body: If it has come off the road or dropped a wheel, we run the line out and bring it back up before anything is loaded.
services.alt: Storage container carried on the flatbed
services.evidence: Delivery box truck recovered onto the carrier deck

services.title: Car and light truck transport
services.body: Cars, pickups and vans ride flat on the deck and are chained at the points the manufacturer put there for it.
services.evidence: Heavy wrecker and a second truck parked together on the yard gravel

services.title: Heavy and oversize loads
services.body: Anything that will sit on a deck can move on one, from plant and trailers to whole buildings.
services.evidence: Garden shed loaded whole onto the flatbed for transport

reviews.author: Jade F.
reviews.text: Super fast response, arrived less than 30mins after call.. driver ran into an issue because my car sat so low; however found a solution very fast. Would recommend.

reviews.author: Kelley Ard
reviews.text: I’ve used this service three times now, and every experience has been excellent. They have the best prices around, the driver is always friendly, and they’re consistently on time. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jeff Morris
reviews.text: Very pleased. I broke down in my work van in front of customer house and they came quick! The gentleman that towed my car was very nice. I will definitely be keeping there number if I ever need quick tow again for good price.

reviews.author: Steve Shin
reviews.text: I had a flat tire driving home from work, and luckily Rex Towing was nearby. A gentleman named David promptly picked up and quickly arranged to have a truck arrive in less than an hour. The driver was professional and courteous, and handled my car with great skill and care. Rex’s is now my go to towing service and I will recommend them to my friends and family. Thank you!

reviews.author: Gavin Keziah
reviews.text: They did an excellent job getting my SUV back home after a seized water pump left me stuck. Very quick response time and the price was excellent. 10/10 would recommend.

reviews.author: Riley Busby
reviews.text: ABSOLUTE pleasure of an experience, but totally beyond that in the best way - literally ~ you have no idea {very very very friendly with absolutely no interferences as well as Good prices making us feel like our car might as well have been takenoch by a genie!tying the car down so well, eminent in service,and best price ever to nail it inm {will always go with this business and I recommend it to all}

reviews.author: Tien Hoang
reviews.text: Well I was driving to work early in the morning and doze off slightly, and then hit the median at 440am. I pull over and look for a towing service. Thank goodness Rex towing came through at such an unexpected hours and helping me ease my mind. The driver also pointed that my rim was bent and is fixable. He's letting me know what to expect when I get my tires switched. The price is reasonable due to the inconvenience and economy. Thank you Rex for coming through.

reviews.author: 12ThouxanPrimo
reviews.text: Five out of five stars called and got a text back within 10 min so if he doesn’t answer he will shortly after that. Great skills would recommend he got my car without even touching the grass in a curved drive way and only took 25 minutes for him to come.

reviews.author: Yjevy Rong
reviews.text: David was really reasonable with pricing, and is very firm with what he says. Just give him a time and place, he'll have someone there.

reviews.author: Alyssa Craig
reviews.text: Very kind people, towed my car for hundreds of dollars cheaper than what other towing companies quoted me and didn’t try to price gouge because I was a woman who knew nothing about cars and was stranded. I really appreciate it.

reviews.author: J Lizzy
reviews.text: 5 stars no question. I called 4 tow truck companies at 4pm Saturday on an emergency flat tire, all with 24/7 service options but only Rex Towing came through. Dave picked up the call promptly and tow truck came quickly. What made this company really earn this commendation is how they handled my car, it’s a sports car that sits low to the ground and now worse with a flat, with no spare tire option and the tire practically shredded….Andrei, the tow truck guy, was nothing less than an expert who efficiently used all kinds of special pads and tools to cover the car properly as the hydraulic lift raised my car without a scratch. On top of all that, no special fees and reasonably charged. Rex took my car to Costco Tires who took care of the rest. Highly recommend. THANK YOU and until next time….

reviews.author: April Quick-Mytrysak
reviews.text: I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this company!! I got my vehicle stuck in the mud in a very peculiar position and difficult to reach area on my farm. Rex Towing sent someone out immediately to help! I was so impressed with the two gentleman who came out & managed to get my vehicle out of the mud & area it was stuck in. Happy customer is an understatement!! Thank you again Rex Towing!!

reviews.author: Justin Hobbs
reviews.text: Would highly recommend this company! I needed a rollback to move my very expensive toolbox (Matco 6s). Called around and Rex by far had the best price! 3 guys showed up within an hour of calling and took extra care of loading and securing my box to the rollback. When they dropped it off, same care was taken and they even pushed up the ramp into the storage unit for me. They did an awesome job and I would definitely call them again if I need a tow!

reviews.author: Queen Nwobi
reviews.text: Amazing company, the guy that picked up my vehicle didn't speak much English but that's what google translate is for people. He was patient and determined and very careful loading my vehicle being that the tire was flat and no key. I will tell everybody about this company. REX TOWING I had to shout y'all out the pricing insanely affordable, I called everywhere and this place is the lowest in the town no price godging guys. They are a true God Send in your time of need it's already an inconvenience when things like this happens possibly leaving you stranded so it's good to have a company like this in your back pocket trust me you will thank me later. I'm also really customer driven and don't usually write reviews because most companies don't care about customer interactions believe me when I say they are top notch!!!!!They towed my car in the rain 2 God bless y'all.

reviews.author: Jemuel Martinez
reviews.text: Just got my car towed today Camry TRD called Rex towing got great customer service over the phone and fair and easy quote. Communication back and forth was good and rfast response. The tow truck driver took good care of me and my car especially my car very low in the front was very careful and took him time leading and even at drop off was very gentle and careful. Would recommend Rex Towing. Thank you for exceptional service.

reviews.author: Jarvis Short
reviews.text: Rex Towing is a top notch, professional company. They have great personnel, prompt service and I enjoyed the entire experience. So glad that I called them, they made my year already. Thanks guys and gals. Professionals at there best is all I can say.

reviews.author: Pat Jarman
reviews.text: We had such a pleasant experience on 4/8/25 with this company. The driver was amazing and handled our vehicle with such care. Do not hesitate to call them.

reviews.author: Justin Roope
reviews.text: Had a very challenging situation and these guys made it happen. Thank you for your willingness to help and not giving up!

reviews.author: Maria Ortiz
reviews.text: Such great service! They came in no time, Adrian the tow truck driver was so kind and very helpful! I can't express enough how sweet he was. I will always recommend this company to anyone and now I know who to call if towing services are ever needed.

reviews.author: Luis Garcia
reviews.text: It took me a phone call to get an excellent service to get my daughter car towed to the closest tire repair. Thank you for your help.

reviews.author: Malik Leathers
reviews.text: I had a great experience with this company. The tow driver was very pleasant with me and took his time loading and unloading the car but still ima timely manner. I definitely recommend this company to anyone needing towing services!

reviews.author: Alec Dupuis
reviews.text: Rex towing is a great company, extremely professional, very reliable, and very affordable. They did a great job helping me with my bike problem, and they will be the first I call from now on. Thank you guys so much

reviews.author: Lana K
reviews.text: Pick up was quick. Driver was very professional. Good to have Rex Towing in your contacts. Recommend

reviews.author: Justin Buchanan
reviews.text: Incredible service and experience! Towed my 14,800lb motorhome to my shop for me after it broke down. They were there in 15 minutes and got it lined up PERFECTLY in place at my shop, not a single issue! Thanks so much guys! 20 stars

reviews.author: Matt Cousino
reviews.text: These guys were awesome! They communicated with me extremely well. Gave me an ETA and were very professional! Best part they are a 24 hour towing service! Anyone in a bind call Red Towing! Affordable and professional!

reviews.author: Walter Hechenbleikner
reviews.text: My truck broke down and they towed it to my garage in York SC. They responded quickly and professionally, had the most competitive price out of several other companies. Great group to work with!

reviews.author: Anamaira Alfonso
reviews.text: Had a fantastic experience with this car towing company, had been out running errands when my car suddenly broke down on the side of the road, with my friend on the phone, he mentioned it, passed my the phone number and right away gave them a call. Speedy response, once the driver arrived, he was able to quickly get my car loaded onto the tow truck. Incredibly grateful, I would highly recommend this car towing company to anyone in need of their services. Overall, I give this car towing company a solid 5 stars for their service. Thank you so much for your help!

reviews.author: Nivea Vailes
reviews.text: THE PEOPLE THAT WORK FOR THIS COMPANY !!!! 10/10!!!!!!!!!! You wouldn’t believe what I had to deal with… I had someone tow my car for me that was also a mechanic so I thought why not kill 2 birds with one stone. Do you know this man would NOT communicate with me at all?! Even after being paid it got to a point where he wouldn’t even tell me where my car was. I found REX TOWING ON GOOGLE !!! And baby they delivered!!!!!!!!! He went and found out where my car was at and brought it to me!!!! Sent pictures to me when my car was picked up, they had it delivered in 30 minutes!!!! I will absolutely recommend this company 1,000 times out of!! THANK YOU SOOOO MUCH REX TOWING!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Maibelys Garcia
reviews.text: I recently had an urgent situation at 3 am, and this towing company was a lifesaver. Their prompt and efficient service not only resolved my issue but also left me incredibly grateful. Five stars for their exceptional assistance!

reviews.author: Misty
reviews.text: If yall need a tow company this is the one to call. Came in 10min after waiting for another company from my insurance for 2 1/2. Will use again! I highly recommend! 2nd time using them, they arrive promptly. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Christina Jones
reviews.text: Rex Towing is awesome! Needed my car towed to mechanic shop, they were at my house within 12 minutes and extremely reasonable. Fast, courteous, inexpensive and friendly service. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!

reviews.author: Tasha Thomas
reviews.text: So professional. The man who arranged everything kept me updated on the driver's ETA. Driver was friendly and efficient. I was hesitant to pay before the service had been completed but the price was fair and I was not disappointed. Thank you guys so much. Other similar services I'd called can learn from you.

reviews.author: Pat Barclay
reviews.text: Rex Towing was a lifesaver for us when I didn’t know where to turn! My elderly husband was stuck beside a major highway in 90 degree heat with a torn up tire thanks to some road debris he hit earlier. We’re new to this area, and I hadn’t quite got around to signing up for road service, but Rex took great care, got there quickly and kept me informed of the tow truck driver’s progress at the scene the entire time. Fortunately, the driver was able to place the spare tire on our car, and husband arrived home, worn out and hot but very grateful for a responsive company like Rex Towing!

reviews.author: Dante and Yesenia Kurtzweil
reviews.text: My son who is away at college had a bad battery. Rex Towing was amazing!!! They came out to him quickly and gave him a jump. Thank you for providing such great service.

reviews.author: Emmett Shuler
reviews.text: 10/10 Would recommend Rex Towing, extremely professional and polite. Had an issue on Hwy 85, called Rex Towing, and they got my vehicle to the shop without skipping a beat. Thank you again for the great customer service!

reviews.author: Amy Jackson
reviews.text: I would 100% recommend Rex Towing. They made a challenging situation manageable and provided quick, convenient, and professional service. Our tow truck driver was excellent, and he went above and beyond to help us. Thank you!

reviews.author: Alesia Anderson
reviews.text: I've used this company twice in the past 2 weeks. Super friendly, professional, quick, and efficient. They also offer the best prices around. Definitely my go to .

reviews.author: Sania Y. Afanador
reviews.text: David was awesome, they picked up the phone quickly, made it to my family in less than 20 minutes. Will definitely contact them again

reviews.author: Jenna Westbrook
reviews.text: I am so grateful to Rex Towing for helping me and my two kids when our car unexpectedly stopped running. After waiting on AAA for almost 3 hours, we called Rex Towing and he was there in just 15 minutes! If there’s a next time we need a tow, we will call Rex Towing first - amazing service!

reviews.author: Claribel Del Orbe
reviews.text: He was amazing, extremely helpful and went above and beyond to help me!! The price was also very good! I will highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Christian Miller
reviews.text: Called them on a Sunday needing emergency tow due to HEAVY personal situation. Insanely friendly, prompt, professional, and had a great attitude! Would recommend to ANYONE needing towing services. 10/10

reviews.author: Taseanna Robinson
reviews.text: Rex Towing was such a big help. With all the rain in the last few weeks, our vehicle was stuck in the back yard. Not only did they show up but communicated very well. Thank you!

reviews.author: Nikki
reviews.text: Super quick and friendly towing. They were even able to fix the problem within a few hours and had our car ready to go.

reviews.author: Maria Hondros
reviews.text: I called and spoke with a very nice gentleman on the phone. They sent a tow truck within 15 minutes. Great service. Thank you guys.

reviews.author: Key Hill
reviews.text: These guys were my heros! Professional, very communicative, and reasonably priced. I’d definitely call them again and recommend them to my friends.

reviews.author: Kevin Rink
reviews.text: Driver came faster than quoted, was super helpful, and gave me a ride to the shop as well. Highly recommend. Will definitely use again

reviews.author: Ryanna Adkins
reviews.text: Rex Towing was great. They got my car quickly and communicated well throughout the entire process. I 100% recommend their service.

reviews.author: Alex Rivenbark II
reviews.text: I backed into a ditch and got stuck. Couldn’t get any other company to even answer the phone. Rex Towing answered right away, responded quickly, and had me out in no time. Top notch service and pricing! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sherry Brown
reviews.text: They are one of the best Towing companies here in Charlotte. They are fast, very reasonable in price and excellent customer service.

reviews.author: Crystal Sanders
reviews.text: Home safe and sound, thanks to these gentlemen. Even waited in the cold with me and my 2 children for our ride. On the side of 218 in the middle of the night!!! Hard to find great people like this! Thank you again!!

reviews.author: Heather Cline
reviews.text: Adrian helped us so much on a Holiday and saved me and my son from having to find a ride and helped us get to a tire shop QUICK!!!!!! -Heather from Hickory NC

reviews.author: A Kelly
reviews.text: Rex towing was able to quickly pick up my car twice in one week. They were super fast and delivey was seamless.

reviews.author: Adam Dove
reviews.text: Very quick to get me back into my car. Answered the phone, responded quickly, and very easy to work with. And I believe a good price as well.

reviews.author: David Wheeler
reviews.text: David showed up earlier than he said which was great. Loaded up my car quick and dropped off at the dealer with no fuss. Thanks again David for helping me out on a Sunday morning!

reviews.author: Ms. Jewel D. Pearson
reviews.text: Responsive, driver came out quickly and within the indicated time. Driver/Tech was friendly, fast and professional. Price was reasonable.

reviews.author: Pablo E Ibanez
reviews.text: This guys are the number one option in Charlotte NC. You are wasting your time with others. They are serious, knowledgeable and helpful. I have used the service and they were excellent in every step of the way.

reviews.author: Alexandra Gonzalez
reviews.text: Great service! My car wouldn’t turn on after I got off work. I called and was able was get my car towed in 25 minutes!

reviews.author: Luis Islas
reviews.text: Definitely recommend reliable & fast great customer service ! Found my new tow guy , btw he’s Low car friendly!

reviews.author: Nicholas Gaetano
reviews.text: I dont know how this place has 5 stars. They were supposed to tow my car and they never showed! Would answer the phone or text. Nothing like leaving a person hanging when they are stranded!

reviews.author: Don Johnson
reviews.text: They came through for us. Called late with a broken down car, and they had a truck on the way. Can't beat the pricing either.

reviews.author: Angelo Briggs
reviews.text: David is the guy if you ever need a towing company, he was not on time but early and we like early, professional and friendly!

reviews.author: Monica Kennedy
reviews.text: Rex towing was great, came right out, very nice guy. Very very reasonable price, cheapest I could find!

reviews.author: Leodan Forcades
reviews.text: Thanks Rex Towing! They were able to pick up my car and take it safely to the mechanic in less time than agreed upon. Their driver, Adrian, was super friendly, and communication with the owner, David, was excellent. I will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Arianna Ramos Malagón
reviews.text: Excellent service. I'm incredibly grateful to this company for their customer service, speed, and skill. Don't hesitate to contact them if you have a problem; they provide an immediate solution. They deserve 5 stars because I've had a wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Adrian Jimenez
reviews.text: Yes, Rex Towing provides excellent towing service. Their team is professional and reliable, always ready to help in roadside emergencies. I highly recommend their services.

reviews.author: Wilfredo Alexandre Forcades Oquendo
reviews.text: Rex, thank you for your service, and thank you to your manager David for his communication with the driver. They never lost my car, which broke down on Highway 485. With just the location, David found it and took it to the agreed-upon address. Thank you, Rex, for your excellent service and good price. Rex Towing is highly recommended.

reviews.author: Luis Miguel Crespo Torres
reviews.text: Excellent service! Very punctual, they arrived right on time. We were able to communicate very well, as they speak both languages. I highly recommend them; they are very efficient!

reviews.author: Yunier Zulueta
reviews.text: Rex Towing is a fantastic company! After calling several companies without getting a response, Rex Towing finally answered my call and resolved my issue. The car arrived on time, and the driver was incredibly friendly throughout the trip. The prices were very affordable. Highly recommended! Thank you, Rex, for your service!

reviews.author: Maria de los angeles Gonzales
reviews.text: Excellent service and very punctual. I would like to congratulate Adrián on his excellent work; he served me very well.

reviews.author: Ojani Cortes
reviews.text: Great service! I recommend them anytime, anywhere in Union County. Great service! I recommend their service anytime, anywhere in your local area of ​​Union County.

reviews.author: Ariadna Molina
reviews.text: Highly recommended!!!! I needed their services and they arrived promptly and skillfully… I am truly and infinitely grateful.
